title: Timeline Effects — Transform, Transition, Blur, Explode, etc.
description: Implement Flash 8 built-in timeline effects (Insert > Timeline Effects): Transform, Transition (fade/wipe), Copy to Grid, Distributed Duplicate, Blur, Drop Shadow, Expand, Explode. Effects auto-generate symbols and tweens from a selected object with a re-editable parameters dialog. Zero implementation exists — no model, no UI, no macro expansion.
